We reproduced. Short summary: a billing service regression updated the org->project tier mapping for Acme's account this morning, which caused the org default quota (60 RPM/project) to be applied to the project. The runtime enforces the lower of project/allocated quotas, so the effective limit dropped and customer traffic hit the token bucket leading to 429s.

Actions taken (09:40-09:44 PST):
- Applied a temporary project-level override to raise the project quota to the previous level (1200 RPM) — should take ~2-3s to propagate to gateway nodes, full smoothing of backpressure ~15-25min.
- Kicked control-plane rollback of the org mapping; rollback in progress (SUP-2341).
- Added an emergency mitigation in the gateway to soften immediate token bucket rejections by allowing a short burst window (20s) for existing connections.

Root cause: billing service incorrectly mapped new projects to the org default when tier was absent (regression introduced in v3.4.2).

Customer-facing note (draft):
Hi Priya — we identified an unintended org-tier mapping change that reduced your project's rate quota. We applied a project-level override and are rolling back the org mapping; you should see error rate fall over the next 20 min. We'll follow up with a full postmortem and remediation plan.

Request: Jordan — we will likely need to offer a service credit (one week of equivalent dedicated capacity hours) and a technical postmortem. Please advise.
